# Internal HR portal

*Client industry: HR tech | Completed: 2022-08-10 | Evidence id: fullstack:case:p09*

## The problem
The client was an HR team handling leave requests over email.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Django, PostgreSQL, a component-based single-page frontend. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project processed 1,800 leave requests in its first quarter.
